Name: Highland Cattle
Author: clockworkzombe
Description:
Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5030029]Gglacier[/url]'s great [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/60]Wee Highland Coos[/url] mod, this mod is another one for highland cattle! 

This one will change both your brown AND your white cattle into Red and Silver Dun highlands respectively.
